meaning.long_meaning: Aashna corresponds to the Persian form आश्ना. Its core lexical sense is familiar, acquainted, known. From Persian āshnā ('acquainted, familiar'). It is not a Sanskrit form; आश्ना is a Devanagari transliteration.
